records.title: product detail page shows the selected product name, description and price
records.acText: Given standard_user is on the inventory page, when they click the product name "Sauce Labs Backpack", then the product detail page shows that product's name, its description and its price.

records.title: adding to cart from the product detail page updates the header cart badge
records.acText: Given standard_user is on the "Sauce Labs Backpack" detail page, when they click "Add to cart", then the header cart badge shows "1".

records.title: back to products returns to the inventory page with the full catalog
records.acText: Given standard_user is on a product detail page, when they click "Back to products", then they land back on the inventory page with all 6 products listed.
